Wall Street’s Top Analysts Upgrades , Downgrades & Initiations 
$AAPL, $BHP, $CBS, $CRL, $DNKN 
Daily HeffX-LTN reviews Wall Street analysts research reports to find new investing and trading ideas for our readers. Some reports cover stocks to buy , and others cover stocks to sell or avoid. 
Below is a list of Wall Street’s Top analysts outlook for Key issues for Tuesday, as follows: 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) was downgraded to Neutral from Outperform at Atlantic Equities. The stock finished -1.76 at 177.00 Monday, with a 52-week trading range of 119.50 – 180.10. 
BHP Billiton Ltd. (NYSE:BHP) analysts downgraded to Market Perform from Outperform at Bernstein. BHP’s American depository shares closed down 0.42% at $49.44 Monday. 
CBS Corp. (NYSE:CBS) was downgraded to Equal Weight from Overweight with a 64 price target at Stephens. 
Charles River Laboratories International Inc. (NYSE:CRL) was downgraded to Hold from Buy with a 111 price target at SunTrust Robinson Humphrey. 
Dunkin’ Brands Group Inc. (NASDAQ:DNKN) was raised to Outperform from Market Perform at William Blair. 
Stay tuned…
